name: Muha Meds 510 Cartridge | Bubblegum Burst
description: Bubble Gum is an indica strain that brings the classic flavor of bubble gum to the cannabis world. With its sweet, sugary taste and hints of fruity undertones, this strain offers a nostalgic and enjoyable experience. The relaxing effects of Bubble Gum make it perfect for unwinding and de-stressing, providing a soothing and calming high that’s ideal for the end of the day.
